drivers.finding: 13.3k-character prompt repeatedly defines candidate/provenance/material semantics; output inflation comes from reconstruct-entire-candidate, per-item provenance, and unconstrained issue/question prose.
Requires explanations for drift, veto, stakes and candidate review; empty branches still require fields.
12.5k-character prompt explicitly requires six families, seven leaves each, and justification even when inapplicable; this is the dominant serialized-output driver.
Requires full reconstruction of candidate and issues plus intent-preservation and reason even when adopting upstream work unchanged.

safe_prompt_changes: Remove instructions for candidate_action once schema removes it
Ask for bounded codes/detail only on positive or exceptional branches
Allow explicit adopt/reference semantics for unchanged candidate/issues
Preserve all materiality, provenance, last-resort, and READY invariants verbatim
